project.title: 5PIC3 live at Fullfillment Music Center
project.description: Live-coded, audio-reactive visuals in Hydra at Fullfillment Music Center.
project.introText: An audio-reactive visual set performed live as 5PIC3 at Fullfillment Music Center, written in Hydra Video Synth in real time.

gridImages.caption: The set opens with the code alone on the wall.
Stretched colour bands near the end of the set.

project.middleText: As is usual in live coding, the code was projected together with the visuals, so the room could watch the patches being typed, changed and broken as the music moved.
project.highlightCaption: The projection across the wall of the venue.
